{"command": "E=<email:d29caa5c>; O=contribution-summary.md
{
echo "# Git Contribution Summary"
echo
echo "Generated $(date +%F) from the local git history of the repository \`co\` (package.json: \"co\" v4.6.0, \"generator async control flow goodness\")."

echo "This is a summary of git metadata only. It contains no source code. Git author fields are self-declared, so this document shows what the history records. It does not independently prove who wrote the commits."
echo
echo "## Identity"
echo "- Configured in repo: $(git config user.name) <$E>"
echo "- Commits matching this email: $(git log --author=$E --oneline | wc -l) of $(git log --oneline | wc -l) total in the repo ($(git log --author=$E --merges --oneline | wc -l) of them merge commits)"
echo "- Active period: $(git log --author=$E --format=%ad --date=short | tail -1) to $(git log --author=$E --format=%ad --date=short | head -1)"
echo "- Repo history span: $(git log --format=%ad --date=short | tail -1) to $(git log --format=%ad --date=short | head -1)"
git log --author=$E --numstat --format= | awk '{a+=$1;d+=$2;f[$3]=1} END{printf "- Lines added / removed: %d / %d across %d distinct paths\n",a,d,length(f)}'
echo "- Release version commits (x.y.z): $(git log --author=$E --format=%s | grep -cE '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$')"
echo
echo "## Commits per year"
git log --author=$E --format=%ad --date=format:%Y | sort | uniq -c | awk '{print "- "$2": "$1}'\
